text: Refines D-0316 and D-0321 for #617, step 6 of #564's plan: configured pytest acceptance is on by default, beside Go. Each pinned Python test is one exact part-relative node ID, run alone through a captured direct pytest or python3 -m pytest template with supported flags, never a shell, -k or a group. A candidate passes only when Invariant's own evidence channel shows exactly one collected item whose call, teardown, session and process all completed. Skips, xfail, deselection, forged or unfinished output and tampering are refused, and unavailable pytest, plugins or fixtures are setup, never evidence. A collection or import failure counts for the base only when structured exceptions show a missing member of a working local production module, imported once by the selected test's file, which the selected test calls unconditionally from the start of its body. A use after return or raise, or in a branch, loop, try, nested function or comprehension, never counts, and every correction needs a normal runtime pass. Every Go and Python invocation gets its transport helper's bytes afresh at a new private path, compiled there for Go, and never reuses a helper a workload could have replaced. No check fetches pytest, and the real offline matrix runs on a pinned Python 3.13 image with pytest 8.3.5, failing rather than downloading when a prerequisite is missing.
